job.title: Senior HR Systems & Process Analyst
job.description:
Senior HR Systems & Process Analyst – UKG

6–9 month engagement | South Melbourne | Hybrid

Fixed-term contract: circa $150,000–$160,000  pro rata
Day-rate option: Circa $750 per day.

Think Talent is partnering with a complex, multi-business organisation to appoint an experienced Senior HR Systems & Process Analyst to support the post-go-live stabilisation, adoption and optimisation of UKG across the Group.

Working as part of a major transformation program, this role sits at the intersection of people, process, data and technology. You will partner with People & Culture, payroll, employees, managers, technology specialists, vendors and implementation partners to improve how UKG operates across a diverse business environment.

This is a hands-on delivery opportunity for someone who can move comfortably between process analysis, stakeholder facilitation, system testing, data insights, change support and issue resolution.

The opportunity

You will help embed and optimise UKG to create simpler, more consistent and effective employee and manager experiences. Your work will focus on identifying post-go-live pain points, improving priority workflows and ensuring enhanced processes transition successfully into business-as-usual ownership.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Reviewing employee and manager workflows to identify system, process and user-experience issues.

  • Analysing workflow performance, exceptions, approval pathways, hand-offs and recurring support requests.

  • Translating operational needs into clear business requirements and practical system improvements.

  • Mapping current and future-state HR processes across the employee lifecycle.

  • Identifying manual workarounds, duplication, process variation and opportunities for automation.

  • Facilitating workshops with People & Culture, payroll and business stakeholders.

  • Gathering user feedback and applying an employee-centred lens to workflows, forms, notifications, approvals and self-service.

  • Analysing UKG data, workflow volumes, exceptions and completion patterns to identify trends and priorities.

  • Investigating issues, establishing root causes and coordinating resolution across internal and external stakeholders.

  • Developing test scenarios and scripts, coordinating user acceptance testing and managing defects through to resolution.

  • Producing practical user guidance, process documentation, communications and training materials.

  • Monitoring system adoption and recommending targeted interventions where required.

  • Managing assigned workstreams, risks, dependencies, decisions and deliverables within program timeframes.

What you will bring

You will be an experienced HR systems, business or process analyst with a strong understanding of how people, payroll, technology and operational processes connect.

You will ideally offer:

  • Demonstrated experience working with UKG in a complex or multi-business environment.

  • Strong HR process analysis, workflow optimisation and process-mapping capability.

  • Experience supporting HR technology implementations, post-go-live stabilisation or optimisation programs.

  • Confidence investigating system, data and process issues and coordinating practical resolutions.

  • Experience developing business requirements, test scenarios and UAT documentation.

  • Strong data analysis and reporting skills, with the ability to turn insights into clear improvement priorities.

  • The ability to facilitate workshops and build alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Practical change, training and adoption experience.

  • Clear communication, sound judgement and a delivery-focused approach.

  • The ability to balance Group-wide consistency with the operational needs of different businesses and employee populations.

What success will look like

During the engagement, you will contribute to:

  • More stable and effective operation of UKG following go-live.

  • Improved employee and manager workflows.

  • Reduced manual work, duplication and avoidable support requests.

  • Faster resolution of system, data and process issues.

  • Improved data quality, reporting visibility and process compliance.

  • Stronger adoption across employees, managers, People & Culture and payroll.

  • Clear documentation and sustainable transition into business-as-usual operations.

This is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of meaningful post-implementation improvements and directly influence the employee and manager experience across a diverse organisation.

If you have strong UKG expertise and enjoy turning complex people-process challenges into practical, sustainable solutions, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Full Stack Developer
job.description:
• Global Sports Technology Platform
  • Melbourne | Hybrid
  • Hands-on role across backend, mobile, data and cloud

THE ORGANISATION

Think Talent is partnering with a well-funded sports technology start-up building a new global platform designed to bring fans closer to the athletes, teams, leagues and moments they care about.

With strong momentum across product, partnerships and investment, the business is moving from beta towards public launch. It is now strengthening its Melbourne-based technology team and bringing greater ownership of the platform in-house.

This is an opportunity to join at a pivotal stage: the foundations are established, the ambition is global and there is plenty still to shape.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you will help build, stabilise and scale a complex, mobile-first platform spanning live sports data, personalised content, fan experiences, AI-enabled workflows and commercial infrastructure.

This is not a narrow feature-factory role. You will work close to the product, architecture and business outcomes, moving between hands-on development, technical problem-solving and pragmatic delivery decisions.

Working alongside Product, Design and Engineering leadership, you will:

  • Own and deliver core product and platform features across mobile, backend, data and cloud services.
  • Build scalable, maintainable APIs and production-grade backend services.
  • Help harden the platform for public launch, improving reliability, performance, observability and security.
  • Diagnose complex technical and production issues across application, data and infrastructure layers.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions covering live data, content, personalisation, AI and commercial functionality.
  • Improve testing, CI/CD, release management, documentation and engineering quality.
  • Work closely with an established offshore development team to strengthen technical handover, code quality and delivery continuity.
  • Translate product requirements into practical technical solutions that can be clearly understood by both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

THE TECHNOLOGY ENVIRONMENT

You do not need to match every technology perfectly, but you will bring strong full-stack fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly.

  • Java and Spring Boot
  • Flutter
  • Python supporting AI and machine-learning workflows
  • Apache Cassandra and high-throughput, low-latency data patterns
  • Google Cloud Platform
  • CI/CD and DevOps automation
  • OpenTelemetry, monitoring, logging and performance diagnostics

ABOUT YOU

You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys solving difficult problems and building products that real customers use.

You are likely to bring:

  • 5+ years’ full-stack engineering experience in a product-led, high-growth or start-up environment.
  • Strong backend engineering capability, ideally using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Experience designing APIs, distributed systems and scalable application architecture.
  • Exposure to NoSQL databases, high-volume data or real-time platforms.
  • Practical cloud, DevOps, deployment and production-support experience.
  • Flutter experience - or the willingness and versatility to work deeply across a mobile-first stack.
  • Experience integrating Python, AI-enabled services or data-driven workflows into production products would be highly regarded.
  • The confidence to work with distributed engineering teams, review code and lift delivery standards.

Just as importantly, you are a strong communicator. You explain complex technical decisions clearly, document your thinking and work constructively across Product, Design, Engineering and commercial teams. You can challenge an idea without creating theatre, and bring clarity when the answer is not immediately obvious.

Experience gained within similarly scaled consumer, marketplace, media, wagering, creator or sports technology businesses would translate well.

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU THRIVE HERE

You enjoy:

• Working close to the product rather than living solely inside a ticket queue.
• Moving between architecture, code, debugging and product trade-offs.
• Taking ownership before every process is perfectly defined.
• Bringing discipline to a start-up without slowing it down.
• Balancing speed with quality, scalability and sound engineering judgement.
• Building something ambitious from an early stage.

WHAT’S ON OFFER

• A defining role as a global sports platform moves from beta to public launch.
• Meaningful ownership of core technology and engineering outcomes.
• Direct access to senior leadership, product strategy and launch-critical decisions.
• The opportunity to influence architecture, standards and the future Melbourne engineering team.
• Competitive salary and meaningful early-stage equity.
• Flexible hybrid working from Melbourne.

If you are a commercially minded engineer who wants to build, solve and influence, not simply maintain, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now.

job.title: Head of Public-Private Partnership & Engagement
job.description:
The Organisation 

Our client delivers services that touch the lives of millions of Victorians. Operating within one of Australia's most significant public-private partnerships, they have been engaged by the Victorian government to deliver and innovate essential services.

As our client continues their transformation and growth journey, they remain focused on strengthening community trust, embracing digital innovation and delivering long-term value for customers, government and the broader community.

The Opportunity

This pivotal enterprise leadership role is responsible for stewarding the 40-year public-private partnership (PPP) framework and associated State engagement. Working closely with the government, this role will also support internal stakeholders with deed interpretation to progress transformation, commercial and sustainable growth outcomes that will modernise and improve service outcomes for Victorians.

If appointed, you will be accountable for:
  • Organisation Leadership - Vision setting and leadership across a small team, fostering service culture, collaboration, accountability and high performance. Proving strategic advice to internal executive and leaders to enable project, commercial, innovation and customer outcomes.
  • Government Relations and Stakeholder Engagement – Leading strategic State relationships and building trusted partnerships that align commercial, policy and operational priorities. Understanding and aligning internal stakeholder interests to strengthen commercial outcomes, risk management and customer value.
  • Contract Negotiation – Providing strategic oversight of the PPP framework, ensuring contractual obligations are managed effectively while balancing commercial outcomes, partnership objectives and long-term value for both parties. Leading negotiations and resolve complex contractual matters through influence and pragmatic consultation.
  • Obligation and Regulations Management - Providing enterprise leadership across regulatory, legislative and governance obligations, ensuring compliance, effective risk management. Monitoring and interpreting legislative change, guiding organisational responses and decision-making to support sustainable partnership outcomes.

The Right Fit 

Success in this role will come from your ability to build trusted relationships across government, executive leadership and key operational stakeholders while balancing perspectives, commercial interests, risk and contractual obligations.

We are looking for a dynamic leader who can quickly understand and synthesise complex information, leverage commercial acumen and apply pragmatic governance mindset to solve problems and negotiate outcomes at pace and scale.

This is a unique role so diverse backgrounds are welcome. To be successful, it is likely that your experience will cut across legal, professional service, government relations, policy, commercial, complex project delivery and stakeholder engagement segments.

What matters most is your ability to lead with influence, interpret complex commercial agreements and create enduring partnerships that deliver sustainable outcomes for the organisation you represent and community they serve.

Why This Role?

Opportunities of this nature rarely become available. If you are a commercial leader who enjoys navigating complexity, leveraging both strategic and execution capability and influencing stakeholders, this role represents a career-defining moment.

You will manage a significant private and public partnership and influence progress and outcomes that will create real value for Victorians and lasting impact across government, business and the community.

Interested? Apply now for prompt consideration or email Ainsley@thinktalent.com.au to organise a confidential conversation.

job.title: People Experience Manager
job.description:
• Optimise culture and people experience across a customer-centric organisation
  • Build scalable people systems, talent capability and workforce foundations
  • Shape capability to drive people growth and business expansion across a national network

The Organisation

This market-leading consumer brand is recognised for creating memorable experiences that bring people together through movement, connection and fun.
With an ambitious growth agenda and a strong commitment to culture, the organisation is investing in the systems, capability and leadership required to support continued expansion. 

As the business scales, there is a significant opportunity to strengthen learning, capability and operational readiness while preserving the energy, values and sense of belonging that define the brand.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Head of People & Culture, you will lead and small team to delivery best in class talent acquisition, business partnering as well as people operations and experience functions across a growing national network.

Partnering closely with leaders across the business, you will build the people systems, processes and capability required to support continued growth, while strengthening workforce planning, talent acquisition, people experience and risk management. 

The Right Fit

We are seeking a commercially minded and people-centric leader with a strong track record of building scalable people functions within growing, multi-site organisations.

You are equally comfortable designing strategic frameworks as you are rolling up your sleeves to drive execution. You thrive in fast-paced organisations, enjoy solving complex people challenges and have a genuine passion for creating environments where individuals and teams can perform at their best.

Essential capabilities to ensure impact include:
  • People Operations & Employee Experience – Demonstrated experience leading People Services, HR Operations and employee lifecycle programs that deliver consistent, scalable and engaging employee experiences.
  • Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning – Proven ability to develop talent strategies, workforce plans and recruitment frameworks that support organisational growth and capability needs.
  • Culture & Organisational Development – Experience embedding organisational values, strengthening culture and designing initiatives that improve engagement, retention and performance.
  • Employee Relations & Compliance – Strong knowledge of employment legislation, employee relations and governance frameworks, with the ability to balance risk management and commercial outcomes.
  • People Systems & Continuous Improvement– Experience implementing and optimising people systems, reporting frameworks and operational processes that improve efficiency, data quality and decision making.
  • Leadership & Stakeholder Influence – Demonstrated ability to lead high-performing teams, coach leaders and influence stakeholders across diverse operational environments.

The Benefits

This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the people foundations of a highly successful and growing organisation.

You will help shape the future employee experience, strengthen leadership capability and contribute to the continued success of a growing national business.

If successful, you will:
  • Lead and develop a service oriented and proactive people and culture team that will enable growth 
  • Partner with an engaged leadership team committed to developing great people and customer experiences.
  • Influence future-fit people strategy across a growing national business.
  • Join a values-led organisation known for its energy, customer focus and strong sense of community.
Interested?

For a confidential discussion, please contact Michelle Mason at Think Talent on 0498 777 813. Otherwise, click "Apply" for prompt consideration.
